g.text: Log in with a personal access token. yojo checks who you are, then keeps the token in your
operating system's keyring. It is never shown, logged, or written to a file.
Jira: your avatar > Profile > Personal Access Tokens > Create token.
Logged in to Jira as example-user. Saved to your keyring.
Confluence: your avatar > Settings > Personal Access Tokens > Create token.
Logged in to Confluence as example-user. Saved to your keyring.
